In the premiere episode of Built Different, billionaire investor and climate advocate Tom Steyer sits down with Forbes’ Elisabeth Brier to break down the rapidly accelerating energy transition. Steyer argues that the economic battle between fossil fuels and clean energy is already "over." They dive into how AI's massive power demands are pushing the grid to its limits and why the fusion of cheap energy and information will fundamentally reshape global capitalism.
